ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle C=90^\circ$, $BD$ is the bisector of $\angle ABC$, $DE \perp AB$, and the foot of the perpendicular is E. If $AC=5$ and $DE=2$, what is the length of $AD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since BD is the bisector of $\angle ABC$, $DE \perp AB$, and $\angle C = 90^{\circ}$,\\
it follows that $DE = CD = 2$,\\
Since $AC = 5$,\\
it follows that $AD = AC - CD = 5 - 2 = \boxed{3}$
